title: Teacher Realizes Cops Think She Murdered Her Husband
description:
Bodycam footage sheds light on the investigation into the stabbing of a New Mexico man in 2020. A local teacher, Heather Fernandez-Hoefer, called 911 about an alleged accident her husband had. When police arrived, they found Robert Hoefer deceased on a bed. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
